strapiBlog.title: Emaar and DWTC Launch Expo Living Community in Dubai South
strapiBlog.short_description: Emaar Properties and Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC) have unveiled Expo Living, a landmark residential community poised to redefine urban living in Dubai.

data.text:
Emaar Properties and Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC) have unveiled Expo Living, a landmark residential community poised to redefine urban living in Dubai. Strategically situated adjacent to Expo City and minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo Living offers residents unparalleled connectivity and a harmonious blend of dynamic city life with serene, community-focused environments. 

Ahmed Al Matrooshi, Executive Director of Emaar Properties, emphasized, "Its prime location next to Expo City and minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport puts residents at the center of it all. Whether for work, travel, or leisure, everything is within easy reach. With its well-planned amenities and design that promotes community living, Expo Living offers a seamless blend of fast-paced city life and peaceful, harmonious living."

About Expo Living

Spanning a total area of 454,747 square meters, Expo Living is meticulously designed to foster a vibrant and sustainable community. The development allocates 357,000 square meters to residential spaces, complemented by 65,274 square meters dedicated to the Dubai Expo Mall, a contemporary shopping destination offering a curated selection of retail, dining, and leisure options. 

Residents will enjoy an array of amenities, including green parks, landscaped courtyards, fitness facilities, yoga decks, outdoor pools, and barbecue areas, all crafted to enhance quality of life and promote social interaction.

data.text:
Expo Living Location

Expo Living boasts a strategic location in Dubai South along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Expo Road (E77), providing seamless connectivity to key areas within Dubai and beyond. Its proximity to major highways ensures residents have easy access to the city's business districts, entertainment hubs, and international airports, making it an ideal choice for those seeking convenience and accessibility.

About Terra Heights

The inaugural phase of Expo Living features Terra Heights, a collection of one and two-bedroom apartments thoughtfully designed to offer open floor plans and views of lush green courtyards. This development embodies the community's commitment to providing a balanced lifestyle that seamlessly integrates modern living with natural surroundings. 
The developers are set to introduce a variety of projects, each contributing to the diverse and dynamic character of Expo Living, presenting lucrative opportunities for those interested in investing in properties for sale in Dubai.

Investment Potential

Expo Living presents a compelling investment opportunity, underpinned by its strategic location, esteemed developers, and comprehensive amenities. The community's accessibility via major thoroughfares ensures swift connections to Dubai's key destinations, enhancing its appeal to both residents and investors. Developed through the collaboration of Emaar Properties and DWTC, both renowned for their excellence in real estate development, Expo Living promises quality and reliability. 

Its proximity to Expo City and the Dubai Exhibition Centre, set for significant expansion, positions it at the heart of Dubai's future growth. The inclusion of the Dubai Expo Mall within the community adds a vibrant retail and leisure dimension, further elevating its attractiveness as a residential and investment destination.

Expo Living by Emaar and DWTC stands as a testament to Dubai's vision for innovative and connected urban living. With its strategic location, thoughtfully designed amenities, and the backing of esteemed developers, it offers a unique opportunity for residents and investors to be part of Dubai's next iconic community. As Amer Al Farsi, Acting Vice President of Real Estate Development at DWTC, stated, "This joint venture represents a significant milestone in expanding and enriching the vibrant community of Expo City Dubai. Together with Dubai Exhibition Centre and Expo Village, Expo Living supports the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan and aims to set a new benchmark for connected, innovative urban living."
